hypotheses.justification: The result holds for every real t. After unfolding rhoC, the first and last branches are the nonnegative constants 1/2 and 0. In each middle branch, the failed first condition gives params.phi < t; together with phi_nonneg this implies 0 ≤ t, replacing both uses of ht.1. The phase-four proof already uses only its branch conditions via rhoC_phase4_nonneg. Thus the same case-split proof works without ht, including for negative t and t > T.
